headword: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン

definitions.explanation: An absorbent pad worn during menstruation to absorb menstrual flow. Sold in convenience stores and drug stores in Japan, often in separate daytime and nighttime varieties.

examples.japanese: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I picked up some sanitary napkins at the convenience store.
There are daytime and nighttime sanitary napkins.

examples.japanese: {生理用|せいりよう}ナプキン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}さ→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ず、⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{捨|す}てて→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Do not flush sanitary napkins down the toilet; please put them in a dedicated bag before disposing of them.

notes:
Combines {生理|せいり} (menstruation; physiology) and ⟦ナプキン→ナプキン：10257_napukin⟧ (napkin). The abbreviated form ⟦{生理用品|せいりようひん}→生理用品：24808_seiriyouhin⟧ is also used to refer to menstrual products generally.
